# Pinned 1Password CLI reference snapshot
# Version: 2.30.3
# Source: https://developer.1password.com/docs/cli/reference
# Used by scripts/check-matrix.ts to verify CLI command coverage.

Usage:  op [command] [flags]

Available Commands:
  completion  Generate shell completion scripts
  document    Manage documents
  events-api  Manage Events API integrations
  inject      Inject secrets into a config file
  item        Manage items
  plugin      Manage shell plugins
  read        Read a secret
  run         Run a command with secrets in the environment
  signin      Sign in to 1Password
  signout     Sign out of 1Password
  user        Manage users
  vault       Manage vaults
  whoami      Get information about the authenticated account

Flags:
  --format string   Format output (human, json)
  -h, --help        help for op
  -v, --version     version for op

Use "op [command] --help" for more information about a command.
